texts.value: Plasmanylethanolamine desaturase involved in plasmalogen biogenesis in the membrane, required for light-induced carotenogenesis (PubMed:12519205, PubMed:18310035, PubMed:22267513, PubMed:31604315). Plasmalogens are glycerophospholipids with a hydrocarbon chain linked by a vinyl ether bond at the glycerol sn-1 position, and are involved in antioxidative and signaling mechanisms, most precisely in sensing photooxidative stress through singlet oxygen (PubMed:31604315). Participates in the light-dependent inactivation of the antisigma factor CarR (PubMed:12519205, PubMed:18310035). Mediates signaling by singlet oxygen, generated via photoexcited protoporphyrin IX (PubMed:22267513)
